title: Retrieval modes: graph-only, vector-only, fused
purpose: Run the same benchmark questions through fused (default), graph-only (vectorLimit 0) and vector-only (graphLimit 0) retrieval and compare recall@K, MRR and nDCG against the benchmark labels.

environment.note: Terraform output region; no AWS call is made by this manifest.

command_notes: KNOWN GAP: modules/services/API.md (main) refuses graphLimit 0 and any vectorLimit other than 30 with 422 UNSUPPORTED_RETRIEVAL_MODE, so graph-only and vector-only cannot run through the public API as deployed. The suite still sends them: the 422 responses are recorded as failed rows (no model call is made on a 422), never dropped. Real graph-only and vector-only numbers need a service or rag change (owners service-engineer / rag-engineer) or an internal-route runner.

Environment names (set by the human before run-experiment.sh): SC_LOADTEST_API_KEY_FILE (mode 600 file outside the repository), SC_LOADTEST_BASE_URL (Terraform output query_api_url), SC_LOADTEST_EXPECT_HOST (its host), SC_LOADTEST_BENCHMARK (path of benchmark-v1.json obtained with git show main:..., outside the repository), SC_RUN_ID (the same token passed to run-experiment.sh --run-id; run-experiment.sh does not export its run id).

HUMAN APPROVAL EDIT (Phase 13 decision 2): the ALB is HTTP only, so the human appends "--allow-insecure-http" to the command array when approving the manifest (ingress limited to the human's /32; rotate the key afterwards). Without it the generator refuses (exit 3) before any request.

Non-loopback rules enforced by loadgen.py and run_suite.py: the manifest must pass validate_manifests.py and be approved, --ledger and --budget-file are refused, and the benchmark SHA-256 must equal loadgen.benchmark.sha256.
scripts/run-experiment.sh refuses a dirty tree: commit the raw results of experiment D first (experiments/README.md, Between experiments).

cost_estimate.basis: model: 27 requests x $0.02101 = $0.57 if every request reaches the model (upper bound; 422 rows cost nothing); window cost as experiment D

dataset_snapshot.notes: labels are benchmark-v1 expected facts (researcher subject ids)

benchmark.how_to_obtain: git show main:<source_path> > <file outside the repository>; pass the file with --benchmark (not copied into this repository)

metrics_to_collect: loadgen raw CSV including returned_researcher_ids and mode
benchmark labels: expected.facts[].subject (kind identity) as the relevant set
explain retrievalModes and indexesQueried per query (loadgen --fetch-explain)
recall@K, MRR, nDCG@K by mode and category (retrieval_metrics.py)
stop_conditions: request cap (27), model-call cap (81) or model cost cap (0.60 USD) reached
ledger of model spend at the loadgen limit (1.80 USD): refuse to start
reproduction: export SC_RUN_ID=<token> SC_LOADTEST_BENCHMARK=<file> SC_LOADTEST_API_KEY_FILE=<key file> SC_LOADTEST_BASE_URL=<query_api_url> SC_LOADTEST_EXPECT_HOST=<its host>; bash scripts/run-experiment.sh exp-e-retrieval-modes --run-id $SC_RUN_ID (approved and --allow-insecure-http added by the human, as for D); analysis: retrieval_metrics.py
